window: Indian theatrical releases, 30 Oct to 9 Nov 2026
method: A rating counts only if seen this session: on the outlet's own page (WebFetch) or in a critics list naming outlet and critic (thereviewmonk.com, Rotten Tomatoes), also opened with WebFetch. Extended-mode WebSearch returned titles and URLs only, no page text, so no rating comes from a search result alone. Established publications only. Ratings published before the film's release date are left out. Where the same review appears under two outlets (Cinema Express and The New Indian Express share critics), it is counted once. Ratings converted to /10 (x/5 x 2; thereviewmonk lists /10); score = mean, rounded half-up to one decimal. Unrated reviews count towards highs and lows only. A point needs 2+ outlets whose text says so. Paraphrases are idly's. idly did not watch the films.
